item.summary: Reflecting the Central Government’s continued commitment to senior citizens, an amount of ₹ 77.98 Crore has been released as Grant-In-Aid to 755 projects under the Integrated Programme for Senior Citizens (IPSrC) component of Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana (AVYAY), for the quarter ending 30 September 2026 in the financial year 2026–27.
item.title: Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana Strengthens India’s Commitment to Dignified Ageing
